description: Searches eBay listings by keyword on one eBay site (domain, default com) and returns up to 20 listings from the first results page (title, url, price, condition, shipping, seller, items_sold). It does not read a single item page, bids or sold-price history; for one item, the REST endpoint /v1/ebay takes an item URL. For prices at other stores use google_shopping_prices. Required: query.

domain.description: eBay site as its domain suffix: com, co.uk, de, it, fr, es, ca or com.au, e.g. "co.uk" for ebay.co.uk. Default com.

query.description: Listing search text, 1-500 characters, e.g. "mechanical keyboard".

results.description: Maximum listings returned, integer 1-20, default 10, e.g. 5.

name: search_ebay
title: Search eBay
